info.name: Eva
info.summary: RAG assistant over your files with Ollama or Groq
info.description:
Index your own Nextcloud files as a knowledge base and chat about them with a Large Language Model via Ollama or optional Groq API. The app reads your files, splits them into chunks, creates embeddings and makes them searchable via RAG. Answers always name the source (file path) the model took the information from.
- Pure PHP and local retrieval. Optional Groq sends messages, file excerpts and tool results to Groq; embeddings use Ollama. - Text files (txt, md, code, csv, tsv, html, json, xml, yaml, toml, rtf, sql, ...), PDF, Office (docx/xlsx/pptx incl. macro/template variants), OpenDocument (odt, ods, odp), EPUB and more. - Hybrid retrieval: vector search + lexical search (BM25), RRF fusion. - The chat can optionally perform actions on the Nextcloud (create, rename, search files and templates) across the whole home space, incl. Notes and Contacts. - No configuration required: embedding and chat model come from your local Ollama instance.
info.author: Benedikt Schächner
